row.evidence: Strapi's docs make SSO available on the CMS Enterprise plan or as an SSO add-on with Growth ($150/month +$50/month/seat), with auto-registration of administrators on first SSO login; the docs, pricing page and help centre never mention SCIM.
row.notes: New in 2026-09. Scored on the self-hosted Strapi CMS admin panel (seats = admin users). Plans: Community free (MIT), Growth $45 per month incl. 3 seats (+$15/month/seat; the page shows monthly prices only), Enterprise Contact sales. SSO is Enterprise, or a Growth add-on at $150/month (+$50/month/seat), using Passport.js OAuth/OIDC strategies (pricing page also says SAML 2.0). No SCIM: 'scim' appears nowhere in the full docs export (docs.strapi.io/llms-full.txt), the pricing page, the SSO feature page or the help-centre sitemap. JIT: SSO auto-registration creates admins on first login with a default role. The Admin API (Admin tokens, free) has no documented admin-user endpoints; the Users & Permissions REST API manages content-API end users, which are not seats. Audit Logs are Enterprise; no audit-log API is documented. Strapi Cloud (hosting) is priced separately and not researched. No Okta OIN, Entra or JumpCloud app (404).

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: SSO available as an add-on: $150/month (+$50/month/seat). Monthly price shown; no annual toggle seen.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Audit Logs in the admin panel; no audit-log API documented.

scim.notes: available=false by absence: no SCIM in the full docs export (llms-full.txt, 0 matches), pricing page, SSO feature page or help-centre sitemap. Admin provisioning is JIT via SSO auto-registration.

audit_log_api.notes: Audit Logs are an Enterprise admin-panel feature; no API documented.

user_api.notes: No documented API for managing admin users (seats). Admin tokens authenticate to the Strapi Admin API, but no admin-user endpoints are documented. The Users & Permissions REST API (/api/users, /api/auth) manages end users of the content API, which do not count as seats.

okta.notes: okta.com/integrations/strapi/ returns 404. Strapi documents an Okta OAuth2 SSO provider configured in code.

fallbacks.notes: SSO auto-registration creates a Strapi administrator with a default role on first SSO login (Enterprise or Growth + SSO add-on). Protocol: Passport.js OAuth/OIDC strategies per docs; pricing page also names SAML 2.0.
